name: zfmv_stream_destructor
description: zFMV_Stream::Destructor releases optional audio/video stream resources, destroys an optional streaming audio sample, closes codec and AVI state, deletes the critical section, and frees the media path.
known_limits: The native smoke covers the initialized empty-stream path: critical-section deletion and media-path free. Audio/video stream branches are source-reviewed against Binary Ninja, with direct zSndSample and Video-for-Windows provider dependencies accepted separately.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV stream/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463dd0 validates audio-buffer free, zSndSample::Destroy, audio-format free, AVIStreamRelease for audio/video streams, codec ICSendMessage(ICM_DECOMPRESS_END), ICClose, video buffer frees, optional surface ensure callback, AVIFileExit, critical-section deletion, and media-path free.
The native smoke initializes an empty zFMV_Stream with a heap media path and critical section, calls Destructor, and verifies the path completes without requiring real AVI resources.
